sheet_notes.Tileset_22_MV.png: Camping: 'Camping' wooden arch sign, picnic tables (plain/with food), kerosene lanterns, firewood, stumps, camp chairs, backpacks, sleeping bags, coolers, and white motorhomes (side/front/rear views). Objects are separate.
sheet_notes.Tileset_23_MV.png: Canvas tents (A-frame and wall tents in blue/green/beige), small wooden poster kiosks (2x2 complete + 1-wide left/right halves that pair), notice board, arrow signposts, camp tables/chairs/cots, campfire, tripod kettle, mushrooms, rocks.
sheet_notes.Tileset_31_MV.png: Street food: red British phone boxes (avoid), canopy-less food carts at y0-1 (canopy poles cut at sheet top), striped-canopy pushcarts (pink at x8-13,y2-4; tan/red at x0-5,y12-14; row 15 canopies belong to carts off-sheet), hot-dog van, kiosk pieces x6-7,y9-13, small food tables, chalkboard signs, taco truck (avoid).
sheet_notes.Tileset_32_MV.png: Pizza kiosk + delivery scooter, vendor-window sprites, rainbow-umbrella produce/flower carts, ice-cream truck (overlaps a vendor sprite - see skip_cells), generator, and many rocky dirt-hole/puddle decals (x8-15) not cataloged.
sheet_notes.Tileset_34_MV.png: Modern playground: helicopter play structure (avoid), red-roof wooden play towers, plastic slides, swing sets, arched climbing bridges, seesaw. Little 1960s value beyond swings.
sheet_notes.Tileset_35_MV.png: Plastic playground pipe tunnels (avoid), floodlight towers (top and side views), log rail beams, and a wooden plank-tier + stepped log-post set usable as small bleachers.
sheet_notes.Tileset_36_MV.png: Basketball half-courts (ground), hoops, same plank-tier/log-post bleacher art and floodlight as sheet 35 - nothing new cataloged.
sheet_notes.Tileset_37_MV.png: More basketball court ground + hoops + floodlights + same bleacher art - nothing new cataloged.
sheet_notes.Tileset_38_MV.png: Striped-grass soccer field ground with white lines and soccer goals/nets - not cataloged (no fairground use; field could serve as infield turf if needed).
sheet_notes.Tileset_55_MV.png: Modular wrought-iron spear fence kit: stone-curb set (x0-7,y1-8) and brick-curb set (x0-7,y8-14) laid out as demo enclosures with 'modular' guide text (do not stamp text cells), diagonal pieces x6-7 and x14-15, plain curb-less iron fence (x8-13,y0-6, row 15), modular raised grass beds x8-13,y7-15.
sheet_notes.Tileset_71_MV.png: Stone statuary in beige sandstone and grey marble: praying angel, urn maiden (dry and water fountains), tall capstone piers, short pedestals/columns, broken columns and broken pedestals, plinth blocks. Columns at x10-15,y0-2 are cut off at the sheet top (skipped).
sheet_notes.Tileset_77_MV.png: Ivy-overgrown versions: two urn-maiden basins and a praying angel. Partial angels at x9-13,y0-3 and x1-5,y13-15 are cut by sheet edges (skipped).
sheet_notes.Tileset_82_MV.png: Graveyard kit: dirt mounds with shovels, grey and beige headstones (tall/cross/round), small slate stones, candles/lanterns, candelabras, wooden cross markers, crows, bats, stone-lidded graves (closed/open/skeletons), bones, bare trees, jack-o-lanterns (avoid).
sheet_notes.Tileset_83_MV.png: Mostly Halloween: ~20 jack-o-lanterns, spooky face trees with hanging pumpkins, vampire coffins with emblems, coffins in graves; one usable fresh dirt grave pit.
sheet_notes.Tileset_84_MV.png: Gothic cemetery architecture: iron-railed square plot enclosure, gothic stone gateways (4-wide tall/short, 3-wide; grey orb = good, red glowing gem = avoid), stone chapel front with attached arched receiving-vault wing. Gates touch each other edge to edge; bottom-row gates at y13-15 are cut off (skipped).
sheet_notes.Tileset_104_MV.png: Beach: tiki beach bar with fish 'Bar' signs (avoid), striped beach/market umbrellas open and closed, beach towels, slat-roof wooden stalls with counters (good midway booths), stools.
sheet_notes.Tileset_105_MV.png: Event stage: big wooden plank stage decks (flat and raised), aluminium truss arch and truss gantry with spotlights (avoid), tripod speakers, amps, metal stage stairs, crowd barriers.
